propositions: AGENTS.md and docs/user-guide.md incorrectly claim that transition/claim --force is CLI-only and not exposed over MCP, contradicting the shipped code and the 2026-08-18 operator ruling.
The force-everywhere policy and absent-attestation audit model must be documented in the transition and claim --force paragraphs to match the ruling and shipped MCP surface.
AGENTS.md start-work-gate paragraph ending must be rewritten to state force is available on library/CLI/MCP and audit depends on absent signed attestation.
docs/user-guide.md claim --force paragraph ending must be rewritten to state force is exposed over MCP and CI can enforce certification checks.
Out-of-scope CLI-only statements (--allow-secret-pattern secret-scan override, bridge setup wizard, release-notes wizard) must remain unchanged.
